title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache/parallelism
author: Jordan Kim
description:
Motivation: Our GitHub Actions config has grown organically with per-repo and per-language workflows that duplicate setup steps, produce long queue times, and suffer from cache misses. This PR consolidates lint, unit test, and release workflows into a smaller set of reusable workflows, reduces redundant setup, and applies cache-key hygiene and parallelism tuning to improve throughput and cache hit rate.

What this PR does: - Introduces a unified lint/test workflow matrix that shares the Node/Python setup and caching steps. - Splits long-running integration jobs into sharded parallel jobs where safe (e.g. e2e shards for browser tests). - Consolidates release automation into a single workflow that reuses build artifacts and adds a dry-run gating step. - Standardizes action versions and bump common actions to pinned versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-node@v5). - Adds a small bash helper (tools/ci/cache-key.sh) to generate stable cache keys based on lockfiles and package metadata. - Adds documentation and migration notes in .github/README-ci.md.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and remove deprecated files - [x] Verify unit and lint matrix runs for Node 18/20 and Py 3.10/3.11 - [x] Add cache-key script and tests - [x] Add parallel shard support and set defaults to conservative parallelism (3 shards) - [x] Run release dry-run and verify artifact reuse

Notes on behavior: This does not change runtime/test logic. Default behavior is backward-compatible; repo-specific overrides can be added via workflow_dispatch inputs or repository-level workflow_call parameters. CI improvements observed in internal dogfood runs: average pipeline time reduced ~28%, cache hit rate increased from ~62% -> ~83%, and median queue wait time reduced by ~45%.

Migration: Repositories with custom GitHub Actions that directly referenced old workflow filenames should update to the new workflow_call entry described in .github/README-ci.md. Ops will roll out a small migration window and automated PR suggestions for top-5 repos that still reference deprecated workflows.

merge_commit_message:
refactor(ci): consolidate workflows and optimize cache/parallelism

Consolidates lint/test/release workflows, pins actions, adds cache-key helper and parallel e2e shards. Improves pipeline latency and cache hit rates.
release_notes: CI: Consolidated lint/test and release workflows to reduce duplicated setup steps and improve cache hit rates. Added tools/ci/cache-key.sh for stable cache keys. Default parallelism for e2e shards set to 3. No user-facing changes. See docs/ops/ci-migration.md for repository migration steps.
